| 資料 | 現有查詢方式 |
|---|---|
| Stars／forks | repo inventory 回應已附帶，初次不需逐 repo 查 |
| Open PR／issue 數量 | 背景 GraphQL 每批最多 **25 個 repo**，只取總數 |
| PR 標題、branch、review、checks | 需要列出 PR，資料量與查詢工作都更多 |

目前進入 REMOTE 後，會替**所有缺少或過期統計的 repo**補數量；共用預設 **15 分鐘 cache**，`r` 強制刷新。這不是每 15 分鐘定時輪詢。例如同一 provider/host 有 100 個 repo 需要補統計，就是 4 個批次請求，不含 repo inventory；請求數也不等於 API 計費點數。[批次查詢](/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/forge/metrics.go:154)、[觸發流程](/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/internal/tui/remote_metrics.go:72)

新功能我會分成：

- **展開 repo**：只載入該 repo 的一頁 PR；大型 repo 的相關篩選也在此時處理。
- **移動游標／搜尋**：只用已載入資料，不發網路請求。
- **查看詳細狀態／diff**：明確選 action 才讀取；merge 前另做必要的即時驗證。
- **重新展開**：先用 session cache，過期顯示標記，由使用者刷新；不背景輪詢所有 PR。

gh-dash 也是按 section/filter 查詢，預設每批 20 筆；官方設定頁另列定時刷新預設為 30 分鐘。PR 查詢可能涉及搜尋、分頁與更多欄位，不能用「取 PR count」的速度推估；目前沒有量測足以判定你感受到的延遲來源。[gh-dash 設定](https://www.gh-dash.dev/configuration/defaults/)、[PR sections](https://www.gh-dash.dev/configuration/pr-section/)

Queue／auto-merge 會清楚顯示原因並提供 forge 入口，讓使用者自行處理。Try 也可加入：用獨立 clone 放在 `tries_root`，沿用既有 archive／graduate 流程。

The guide documents task-free cleanup\n  and sharing `dev repo list --json` with optional project navigation adapters;\n  existing task commands and JSON contracts remain unchanged.\n\n## [0.3.2] - 2026-09-25\n\n### Added\n\n- `dev repo clone OWNER/REPO --fork` creates or reuses a verified personal\n  GitHub fork while cloning the current source; `dev repo fork [repo-or-path]`\n  connects an existing checkout. Both configure `origin` as the fork and\n  `upstream` as the source, preserve branch pull targets, and direct default\n  pushes to the fork. Preview with `--dry-run`; neither command pushes or opens\n  a PR, and failures retain completed work.\n\n## [0.3.1] - 2026-09-24\n\n### Added\n\n- Try graduation opens a shared terminal/dashboard wizard for the project name,\n  category and local/add-URL/create-remote choice, then previews and confirms the\n  move. `--remote-url`, `--forge`, `--namespace`, `--visibility` and `--yes` also\n  support direct scripts; dry-run stays promptless and never publishes.\n- Successful local graduation remembers an optional project name for later\n  demote/regraduate cycles. Existing records derive a valid legacy destination\n  basename without read-time migration; an explicit name always wins.\n\n### Changed\n\n- Existing remotes are preserved during graduation, including local renames.\n  New remote creation defaults to private with push, while adding an existing\n  URL defaults to no push; explicit push flags remain authoritative.\n- Remote add/create/push failures return nonzero and retain the completed local\n  graduation and any remote effects, without automatic retries or rollback.\n  Publication revalidates the checkout and reviewed branch/commit before each\n  stage; changed authority after remote creation retains the remote and skips push.\n\n### Fixed\n\n- Detect actual terminals instead of treating every character device as a TTY,\n  so redirected commands, including graduation with `/dev/null` input, remain\n  noninteractive instead of entering a wizard and canceling at EOF.\n- Decode quoted and escaped Git configuration values so local remote URLs,\n  including Windows paths, are preserved correctly in catalog metadata.\n\n## [0.3.0] - 2026-09-24\n\n### Added\n\n- `dev help --tree` exposes canonical command families, with a two-level default,\n  `--depth 0` for the full tree, optional command-path focus and `--aliases`.\n- `dev tries demote` returns a previously graduated Try to its original or an\n  explicitly selected safe Try path, preserving current files, Git history,\n  remotes and catalog metadata.
